question: For each agency, show its id and how many distinct clients it has enrolled in programs.
reply:
```sql
SELECT agency.agency_id, COUNT(DISTINCT enrollment.client_id) AS distinct_client_count
FROM agency
LEFT JOIN enrollment ON agency.agency_id = enrollment.agency_id
GROUP BY agency.agency_id;
```
